plow.name: Arar

sow.name: Siembra

texts.NASA POWER ofrece datos regionales con r: NASA POWER provides regional data with a delay. The date shown is the latest available day.
texts.No hay clima NASA disponible ahora. La e: NASA weather data is unavailable. The assessment uses your answers and the crop catalogue; check the data before sowing.
texts.No pudimos preparar tu recomendación. Re: We could not prepare your recommendation. Check your connection and try again.
texts.Con los datos de tu parcela, todavía no: Your plot data is insufficient for a reliable recommendation.
texts.Ningún cultivo de nuestra lista se cosec: None of the listed crops can be harvested in your chosen months. Try other months.
texts.Ningún cultivo llega a 4 estrellas con l: No crop reaches 4 stars with your plot data. These are the closest options and their limitations.
texts.Necesita riego, y tu parcela depende de: Requires irrigation, while your plot relies on rainfall.
texts.Es de la misma familia que tu campaña pa: Belongs to the same family as last season's crop. Let the soil rest.
texts.Con su ciclo, no llega a cosecharse en l: Its growing cycle does not allow harvest in your chosen months.
texts.Tu parcela está fuera de la altura en qu: Your plot's elevation is outside this crop's suitable range.
texts.La temperatura de tu zona está fuera de: Your area's temperature is outside this crop's tolerance.
texts.De noche puede hacer frío para este cult: Nights may be too cold for this crop. Protect it on cold nights.
texts.Necesita más abono o insumos que los que: Needs more fertilizer or inputs than you currently use.
texts.Llovió muy fuerte: revisa que el agua no: Heavy rain: check that water is not pooling in the field.
texts.Con humedad alta y calor, este cultivo p: Warm, humid conditions can encourage fungal disease. Check the leaves regularly.
texts.Tu tierra es arenosa: el agua se va rápi: Sandy soil drains quickly. Water more often in smaller amounts.
Clay soil retains water. Avoid overwatering and waterlogging.
texts.La recomendación se basa en clima y alti: The recommendation uses weather and elevation. Soil data will be checked when a connection is available.
texts.Estás en zona alta: de noche puede helar: At high elevations, frost is possible at night. Check the forecast before sowing.
texts.Dependes de la lluvia: siembra cuando em: You rely on rain: sow when the rainy season begins.
texts.Todavía no tenemos el clima de hoy, así: Today's weather is unavailable, so temperature was excluded from the assessment.
texts.Este navegador no tiene lectura de voz d: Speech is unavailable in this browser.
texts.¿Te gustaría saber qué sembrar?: Would you like to know what to grow?
texts.¿Qué significa un milímetro de lluvia?: What does one millimetre of rain mean?
texts.Un milímetro de lluvia equivale aproxima: One millimetre of rain is roughly one litre of water per square metre. Compare recorded rain with soil moisture before deciding whether to water.
texts.La altitud influye en la temperatura y e: Elevation affects temperature and frost risk. Use your district elevation as a reference and observe conditions on your own land.
texts.Alternar cultivos ayuda a cuidar el suel: Rotating crops protects soil and reduces problems caused by repeatedly growing the same plant family. Confirm a suitable rotation with local advice.
After potatoes, grow barley or broad beans. Avoid potatoes in the same place repeatedly.
After potatoes, grow broad beans or beans. Avoid repeating potatoes or tomatoes in the same place.
texts.Rotar con papa o haba. Mantener el desca: Rotate with potatoes or broad beans. Keep the fallow period short.
texts.Después de cebada conviene haba o arveja: After barley, grow broad beans or peas to help restore the soil.
texts.Mejora la tierra. Va bien después de cer: Improves soil. Suitable after cereals or potatoes.
texts.Alterna con haba o frejol para devolver: Alternate with broad beans or beans to help restore soil nitrogen.
texts.Alterna con haba o frejol. No lo siembre: Alternate with broad beans or beans. Avoid planting after maize.
texts.Alterna con frejol u hortalizas para cor: Alternate with beans or vegetables to break pest cycles.
texts.Es un árbol. Entre hileras puedes sembra: A tree crop. Grow green manure such as vetch between the rows.
texts.Es un árbol. Mantén el suelo cubierto co: A tree crop. Keep the soil covered with grass or straw.
texts.Rotar con cereales o frejol. No repitas: Rotate with cereals or beans. Avoid repeating potatoes or tomatoes.
texts.Rotar con haba o frejol. No repitas cebo: Rotate with broad beans or beans. Avoid repeating onions or garlic in the same place.
texts.Rotar con haba o cereales. No repitas ca: Rotate with broad beans or cereals. Avoid repeating sweet potato in the same place.
texts.Rotar con cereales. Cambia el lugar de l: Rotate with cereals. Move strawberry beds every three years.
texts.Es perenne. Al renovar el lote, deja des: A perennial. When renewing the plot, rest the soil with green manure.
texts.Es perenne. Cubre el suelo entre plantas: A perennial. Cover the soil between plants to protect it.
texts.Es perenne. Mantén sombra y cobertura en: A perennial. Maintain shade and soil cover.
texts.Es perenne. Entre plantas puedes sembrar: A perennial. Grow legumes such as beans between plants.
texts.Aguanta el frío y la poca lluvia. Es una: Tolerates cold and low rainfall. Suitable for high elevations.
texts.Aguanta el frío, las heladas y la poca a: Tolerates cold, frost and limited water. Suitable for high elevations.
texts.Cuando renueves el campo, deja descansar: When renewing the field, let the soil rest and add fertilizer.
texts.Dura muchos años. Necesita riego seguido: Lasts many years. Needs regular irrigation and loose soil.
texts.Es un árbol que dura muchos años. Entre: A tree that lasts many years. Grow green manure, such as vetch, between trees.
texts.Es un árbol que dura muchos años. Mantén: A tree that lasts many years. Keep the soil covered with grass or straw.
texts.Le gusta el agua y el calor. Necesita un: Needs water and warmth. Requires land that can stay wet.
texts.Le gusta el calor. Necesita riego, pero: Prefers warmth. Needs irrigation without waterlogging.
texts.Le gusta el clima templado. Necesita rie: Prefers mild weather and moderate irrigation.
texts.Luego siembra cebada o haba. Y no vuelva: Then grow barley or broad beans. Avoid potatoes in the same place next year.
texts.Luego siembra cereales o frejol. Evita s: Then grow cereals or beans. Avoid tomatoes or potatoes in the same place.
texts.Luego siembra frejol o hortalizas. Ayuda: Then grow beans or vegetables to help break pest cycles.
texts.Luego siembra frejol o hortalizas. No re: Then grow beans or vegetables. Avoid repeating onions or garlic in the same place.
texts.Luego siembra haba o arveja en el mismo: Then grow broad beans or peas on the same land to help restore the soil.
texts.Luego siembra haba o frejol en el mismo: Then grow broad beans or beans on the same land to help restore the soil.
texts.Luego siembra haba o frejol. No siembres: Then grow broad beans or beans. Avoid potatoes in the same place repeatedly.
texts.Luego siembra papa o haba. Así la tierra: Then grow potatoes or broad beans to avoid exhausting the soil.
texts.Necesita agua y abono. Cuida que no se j: Needs water and fertilizer. Prevent water from pooling in the soil.
texts.Necesita riego constante. No la dejes si: Needs regular irrigation. Keep it watered during hot weather.
texts.Necesita sol y agua seguida. No lo siemb: Needs sun and regular water. Avoid sowing while frost is still possible.
texts.Necesita sol, agua seguida y abono. Quít: Needs sun, regular water and fertilizer. Remove dry leaves.
texts.Pregunta a tu vecino qué sembrar después: Ask a neighbour what to grow next to avoid exhausting the soil.
texts.Se da bien en zonas frías y altas. Las v: Grows well in cold, high areas. Native varieties cope better with local weather.
